stem: With which statement would both the author of the selection and the poet most likely agree?

options.label: F
options.text: The uncertainties of space travel make it unlikely that many people will want to leave Earth.

options.label: G
options.text: It will be difficult to develop technology more advanced than it already is.

options.label: H
options.text: Space travel will one day be a commonplace occurrence for many people.

options.label: J
options.text: The creation of new technology is influenced by the technology described in science fiction books.
